name: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Co., Ltd.
summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various electronic components in Korea, China, Southeast Asia, Japan, the Americas, and Europe. The company operates through three segments: Component, Package Solution, and Optics Solution. It offers multilayer ceramic capacitors, inductors, tantalums, and chip resistors; camera modules; package substrates; and semiconductor PKG boards. The company is also involved in the real estate and real estate software, as well as investment business.
